# linux-computer-use

> An open source computer use agent for Linux: an MCP server that lets Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, or any MCP client drive a real browser on your own Linux machine, with a live view, human takeover, and safety guardrails.

Self-hosted browser automation for AI agents on Linux, an alternative to cloud-hosted computer use products. Node.js MCP server wrapping playwright-cli. Drives Chromium, Chrome, Firefox, and Chromium-based browsers (Brave, Opera, Edge) over CDP. Requires Linux, Node.js 20+, and a browser. Licensed MIT. Owner: Roadmvn.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/Roadmvn/linux-computer-use/blob/main/README.md): what it is, install, tool reference, comparison with other computer use agents, FAQ
- [Design notes](https://github.com/Roadmvn/linux-computer-use/blob/main/docs/design.md): architecture, control lease between agent and human, guardrails, audit trail
- [Repository](https://github.com/Roadmvn/linux-computer-use): source, issues, releases

## Install

- [install.sh](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Roadmvn/linux-computer-use/main/scripts/install.sh): one-line installer, run with `curl -fsSL <url> | bash`

Register with a client:

The installer places the server in `~/.linux-computer-use/app` and prints these:

- Claude Code: `claude mcp add --scope user linux-computer-use -- node ~/.linux-computer-use/app/src/index.js`
- OpenAI Codex: `codex mcp add linux-computer-use -- node ~/.linux-computer-use/app/src/index.js`

## MCP tools

- `open`: open or attach a browser session (url, session, profile, browser)
- `goto`: navigate to a URL (url)
- `snapshot`: accessibility tree of the page with element refs
- `screenshot`: image capture of the page
- `click`: click an element by ref (ref)
- `type`: type text (text)
- `fill`: fill a field by ref (ref, text)
- `press`: press a key (key)
- `mouse`: mouse by coordinates, vision mode (action, x, y)
- `tabs`: manage tabs (action: list, new, select, close; index, url)
- `history`: history navigation (direction: back, forward, reload)
- `status`: session and control lease state
- `set_mode`: switch between normal and auto mode (mode)

## Features

- live view of the browser in a web dashboard, reachable from another machine
- human takeover: click the viewport to take control, Escape to hand it back
- visible agent cursor drawn on the page
- named isolated sessions, persistent profiles, reuse of existing cookies
- act by accessibility tree (robust) or by pixel coordinates (canvas and custom widgets)
- guardrails: stops on empty login forms, asks when several accounts are offered, confirms irreversible actions
- auto mode for complete objectives that can run unattended

## Related

- [Model Context Protocol](https://modelcontextprotocol.io): the protocol the server implements
- [Playwright](https://playwright.dev): the browser automation stack it builds on
